inputs.ad_text_01: Black-and-white observational documentary footage for a serious economics explainer. Neutral grayscale silver-gelatin photography, detailed faces and material textures, soft daylight, moderate contrast, clear readable composition. Original illustrative reconstruction. Natural restrained gestures, physically coherent objects and hands. Landscape 16:9. One continuous shot, gentle camera movement only. No subtitles, no readable lettering, no logos, no watermark, no graphic overlays. Medium shot of two East Asian economic researchers at a desk. They agree on a short checklist, place it visibly at the side, then open a sealed folder containing additional case records and compare the new records with the checklist. Printed sheets contain only indistinct markings. Methodical testing, no fabricated readable charts.
